mccourt_guide.text: This was Leamy's School, where Frank McCourt went as a boy. We've a classroom set up as it was in the 1930s: inkwells, slates and a master with a strap.

Frank grew up in the lanes, emigrated to New York at nineteen, taught in schools there for thirty years and then wrote it all down. Angela's Ashes came out in 1996 when he was sixty-six. Never too late.

mccourt_reader.text: 'Tis, the sequel, is about New York. Teacher Man is about teaching. I've read all three twice. My copy of Angela's Ashes is mostly sellotape.
